blends.name: Pepetole evolution to Gyrapepe.
blends.desc:
This is a random evolution of Pepetole into any of the 5 results to a Gyrapepe.

Requirement is to burn 1 Serum.

20% possibility of any of the 5 results.

Good luck!

blends.name: Companion - Pepetole

First ever Endless Loot World companion is here!

Hatch your [Alien Egg](https://neftyblocks.com/c/endlessloots/drops/78420) and get a random mint Alien Dog.

blends.name: GrovFest 2021Superblend
blends.desc:
You will need 1 adventurer backpack NFT + 1 Grov NFT for the super blend. Each craft (blend) will grant you one of the following:

60% [Empty Grov Mug](https://wax.atomichub.io/explorer/template/endlessloots/327449)
30% [Backpack Add-on - CamelGrov](https://wax.atomichub.io/explorer/template/endlessloots/327454)
10% [Misc. Weapon - Grovlotov](https://wax.atomichub.io/explorer/template/endlessloots/327477) 

Mint numbers will be on demand, but mint number 1 will be reserved for special perks.

We will be holding several events this week:
- Friday the 15th: Best Grov Recipe - mint #1, Empty Mug
- Monday the 18th: Best Grov Picture - mint #1, CamelGrov
- Tuesday the 19th: Best Grov Poem - mint #1, Grovlotov

Be on the lookout for some giveaways too!

NOTE: only the first 101 mints of Unfired Grovlotov will get airdropped the [Misc. Weapon - Grovlotov](https://wax.atomichub.io/explorer/template/endlessloots/327450), the template has a limited supply of 101 mints.
